## 1. Insiemi, parametri e variabili decisionali

- \(J=\{J_1,\dots,J_7\}\): set dei lavori.
- \(M=\{A,B\}\): set delle macchine.
- \(E=\{(j,m)\in J\times M \mid \text{il tempo di lavorazione è definito}\}\). Dalla tabella:
  \[
  E=(J\times M)\setminus\{(J_7,A)\}
  \]
- \(p_{j,m}\): tempo di lavorazione del lavoro \(j\) sulla macchina \(m\), per \((j,m)\in E\).

Variabili:
- \(x_{j,m}\in\{0,1\}\), per \(j\in J,\ m\in M\): vale 1 se il lavoro \(j\) è assegnato alla macchina \(m\);
- \(C_{\max}\ge 0\): makespan, cioè il massimo carico tra le due macchine.

## 2. Formulazione matematica

\[
\begin{aligned}
\min \quad & C_{\max} \\
\text{soggetto a} \quad
& \sum_{m\in M} x_{j,m}=1 && \forall j\in J,\\
& x_{J_7,A}=0 && \text{(incompatibilità)},\\
& \sum_{j\in J:(j,m)\in E} p_{j,m}x_{j,m} \le C_{\max} && \forall m\in M,\\
& x_{j,m}\in\{0,1\} && \forall j\in J,\ m\in M,\\
& C_{\max}\ge 0.
\end{aligned}
\]

import json
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

jobs = ["J1", "J2", "J3", "J4", "J5", "J6", "J7"]
machines = ["A", "B"]

p = {
    ("J1", "A"): 7, ("J2", "A"): 6, ("J3", "A"): 8, ("J4", "A"): 5,
    ("J5", "A"): 9, ("J6", "A"): 4,
    ("J1", "B"): 9, ("J2", "B"): 5, ("J3", "B"): 7, ("J4", "B"): 8,
    ("J5", "B"): 6, ("J6", "B"): 7, ("J7", "B"): 5,
}

model = gp.Model("bilanciamento_due_macchine")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

x = {}
for j in jobs:
    for m in machines:
        x[j, m] = model.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"x_{j}_{m}")

Cmax = model.addVar(lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="Cmax")

model.addConstr(x["J7", "A"] == 0, name="incompat_J7_A")

for j in jobs:
    model.addConstr(
        gp.quicksum(x[j, m] for m in machines) == 1,
        name=f"assign_{j}"
    )

for m in machines:
    model.addConstr(
        Cmax >= gp.quicksum(p[j, m] * x[j, m] for j in jobs if (j, m) in p),
        name=f"load_{m}"
    )

model.setObjective(Cmax, GRB.MINIMIZE)
model.optimize()

if model.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    variables = {f"x_{j}_{m}": x[j, m].X for j in jobs for m in machines}
    variables["Cmax"] = Cmax.X
    out = {
        "status": "OPTIMAL",
        "objective": model.ObjVal,
        "variables": variables,
    }
else:
    out = {
        "status": str(model.Status),
        "objective": None,
        "variables": {},
    }

}

model = gp.Model("Bilanciamento")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

x = {}
for j in jobs:
    for m in machines:
        x[j, m] = model.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"x_{j}_{m}")

Cmax = model.addVar(lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="Cmax")

model.addConstr(x["J7", "A"] == 0, name="incompat_J7_A")

for j in jobs:
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[j, m] for m in machines) == 1, name=f"assign_{j}")

    model.addConstr(
        Cmax >= gp.quicksum(p[j, m] * x[j, m] for j in jobs if (j, m) in p),
        name=f"load_{m}"
    )

model.setObjective(Cmax, GRB.MINIMIZE)
model.optimize()

if model.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    variables = {f"x_{j}_{m}": x[j, m].X for j in jobs for m in machines}
    variables["Cmax"] = Cmax.X
    out = {
